limitations: Single D0 15s measured load with commit instruments enabled; no paired control for payment throughput and no overhead calibration
Before health had JFR enabled; after health follows restart/index creation; query-plan red/green independently confirms scan change
Commit-stage global event counts include engine calls without durable writes and are not transaction/fsync/payment counts
Concurrent stage/file/statement timers overlap and cannot be summed into wall-clock or attributed to one payment
New nonunique indexes add startup construction/storage/write cost; pending queue growth remains proportional work
No full platform/frontend/browser rerun: platform source/JAR unchanged; remote CI not executed
